system.notes:
Value −1 to −4. Whenever the character handles a piece of equipment, roll 2D6: on a 2 it breaks down.

  • 1 point: +1 or −1 against the character on Success Tests and effect values (Power, Flux, MPCP…); a Simple Action banging it on a hard surface makes it work normally during the character's next Combat Phase.
  • 2 points: it doesn't work; a sharp jolt (Simple Action) brings it back on-line in the character's next Combat Turn.
  • 3 points: major malfunction, +2 or −2 against the character until repaired (cost × 0.2 plus labour).
  • 4 points: breaks down; only a major overhaul fixes it (cost × 0.5 plus labour).

Driving a vehicle: one major subsystem or modification goes down (the gamemaster rolls or picks). No effect on cyberware, bioware or magical equipment; hermetic libraries on electronic media can be hit.
